about: The operations of the LetzBill node. The generator (tools/generate-operations.mjs) reads this file and the OpenAPI document named in 'openapi', checks every name here against that document, and writes 'output'. A field, path or parameter this file names that the document lacks fails the generator.

booleanCopy.active: Whether the webhook endpoint is active
booleanCopy.auto_collection: Whether LetzBill collects payment for the subscription automatically
booleanCopy.exclude_from_dunning_campaign: Whether the customer is left out of dunning campaigns
booleanCopy.include_metadata: Whether to include the invoice metadata
booleanCopy.include_snapshot: Whether to include the customer snapshot taken when the invoice was issued
booleanCopy.include_voided: Whether to include voided usage events
booleanCopy.invoice_requires_successful_payment: Whether wallet top-up invoices wait for a successful payment
booleanCopy.overdue: Whether to return only overdue invoices
booleanCopy.receipt_eligible: Whether to return only succeeded payments that have no receipt yet
booleanCopy.reset_consumed_credits: Whether to reset the consumed credits of the wallet
booleanCopy.skip_invoice_custom_sections: Whether invoices for the customer leave out custom sections

inputCurrencyFrom.CreditNoteCreate.credit_amount_cents: the currency of the invoice being credited
inputCurrencyFrom.CreditNoteCreate.refund_amount_cents: the currency of the invoice being credited
inputCurrencyFrom.CreditNoteItemInput.amount_cents: the currency of the invoice being credited
inputCurrencyFrom.OneOffFeeItem.unit_amount_cents: the currency of the customer being invoiced

EventResponse.precise_total_amount_cents: fractional minor units without a currency

WalletTransactionResponse.credit_amount: wallet credits, not a currency amount
